title: Stage-2 reminder send wiring (prefetch -> per-recipient continue_url) has no test; both ends pinned, the mapping between them is not
detail: The recipient->draft mapping (dict build, lowercase keying, token !="" guard, /resume/ URL join, prefetch-failure degradation) can regress silently: draft holders then get the plain CTA or a broken link. Send boundary is policy-untestable, but the pure mapping is extractable.
recommended_fix: Extract a pure stage2_continue_url(draft_tokens, application_url, email) helper (plus the rows->dict fold) and unit-test the lowercase lookup, empty-token guard, and URL join.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: Chunk-2 traceability: P0 100% — all four draft endpoints (happy + 400/closed/uniform-404/cooldown/replay-404), the r3 no-oracle response (`body |> string.contains("sent") |> should.be_false`), strip-on-submit via real handle_post_form, erasure tombstone, expiry sweep, cascade, and the CSRF/public-path/redact/body-size security arms are integration- or unit-pinned. P1 ~95% — field filter, all 8 SQL queries (incl. 10-min window, fan-out bound, 500 cap), resume page + backdated timing, sanitize snippet, email builders both variants; sole partial is the stage-2 send composition (finding above). Overall ~96% >= 80%.
recommended_fix: Gate passes; no action required. Extracting and pinning the stage-2 recipient->continue-url mapping (finding above) would close the one partial.
